observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Kayleen Babel teaches in a friendly, encouraging manner, offering detailed step-by-step breakdowns followed by practice with counts. She provides modifications for different ability levels and explains technical elements clearly.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstration of the contemporary combination to music.
Introduction and explanation of mirroring and modifications.
Breakdown of the first section counts 1 through 8.
Slow practice of the first section with counts.
Practicing the first section with music.
Adding the second part of the combination.

safety: Be careful of sweating and slipping when going to the floor
